assertion: 审计记录不可被普通用户修改或删除。

data_immutability.note: after_total grew due to legitimate audit entries from the batch's own operations; no record was removed or altered

deviation_finding.detail: handleAudit (internal/hub/api/api.go:1865) has no HTTP method switch; POST/PUT/DELETE /api/audit all return 200 with the audit list instead of 405 Method Not Allowed.
deviation_finding.impact: No mutation occurs (store exposes only AddAudit/ListAudit/CountAudit), so the immutability assertion still holds. But a write-shaped request receives a success-looking 200, which is misleading API semantics.
deviation_finding.severity: low (no false success path in the shipped UI; audit page exposes no write controls)
